title: UneceDisability
description: A physical or mental condition that limits a guest's movements, senses, or activities.

description.description: A textual description of this guest disability.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this guest disability.

registeredDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value when this guest disability has been registered.

requiredSupportingDevice.description: A supporting device, expressed as text, for this required guest disability.

restriction.description: A restriction, expressed as text, for this guest disability.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of guest disability.
